t: Founded by Alexander's general Antigonus I, the dynasty lost Asia at Ipsus in 301 BCE but won Macedon under Antigonus II Gonatas.
From Pella its kings dominated Greece with the sarissa phalanx and garrisons at Corinth, Chalcis and Demetrias.
Philip V's alliance with Hannibal began a series of wars with Rome that ended at Pydna in 168 BCE.
dyk: The Colossus of Rhodes is said to have been paid for by selling the siege engines that Demetrius Poliorcetes left behind after his failed siege of the city in 305–304 BCE.
ev: Antigonus I and Demetrius take the royal title after the naval victory off Salamis
Antigonus I is killed at the Battle of Ipsus
Antigonus II Gonatas defeats the Gauls near Lysimachia and wins Macedon
Aratus of Sicyon seizes Acrocorinth from its Macedonian garrison
Antigonus III Doson defeats Cleomenes III of Sparta at Sellasia
Philip V allies with Hannibal against Rome
Rome defeats Philip V at Cynoscephalae
Perseus is defeated at Pydna; Rome abolishes the monarchy
